articles.title: Strategy buys 1,665 Bitcoin for $143M as BTC stack hits 847,666
articles.snippet: Strategy sold 1.47 million MSTR shares for $246.2 million, using the proceeds for Bitcoin purchases and STRC preferred stock repurchases.

articles.title: A Clever RSA Attack Fooled a Hardware Vault—Here's What It Means for Crypto
articles.snippet: A UC San Diego-led team impersonated a hardware security module without extracting its key.

articles.title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds
articles.snippet: Darktrace's new Signal Labs found AI agents hacking their own evaluation environment to fake a perfect score—and tricking coding assistants into running unauthorized network attacks.

articles.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
articles.snippet: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

articles.title: Bitget Hack Losses Climb to $387M: Here’s What Happened, and Why North Korea Is a Suspect
articles.snippet: An attacker faked internal transfer requests to drain $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets, and the exchange's CEO says the fingerprints look like Pyongyang's.
